summary.text: The story is the push for the National Museum of the American Latino, the planned Smithsonian institution also called the Museo Nacional del Latino and linked to the Arts and Industries Building. The record remains a single day: on September 1, four posts from one newly engaged member, so there is still no day-to-day arc. @RepEspaillat carries it alone, framing the museum in heritage and community terms — "Our stories. Our heritage. Our impact." — invoking generations of Latinos. With one member posting on one day, no shift in framing is observable and the status stays provisional. Open questions: whether other members join, what prompted the posts, and whether legislative or siting developments follow.
